title: Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408): hoax, cipher or language

steps.what: Five sweeps, one per hypothesis or evidence class.
Conditional entropy h2 across transliterations and glyph segmentations against eleven European languages.
Plaintext, monoalphabetic substitution, transposition, abjad or single-null padding of eleven European languages.
Verbose-cipher controls of Latin: matches h1/h2 but gives words 2.3 times too long.
Implemented hoax generators (table-and-grille, self-citation autocopist) against word grammar, Zipf and self-citation statistics.
Adversarial re-run of every test by a separate agent; corrected figures adopted.

outcome.notes: An adjudication, not a decipherment: verbose encoding vs structured meaningless text judged about 45:50.

prior.where: Published decipherments (Bax 2014 to 2025-26 LLM readings) have no reproducible key

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
